svg.title: Nightingale — AI interprets. Verified data decides.
svg.desc: Explicit user observations reach a deterministic route engine. Human-verified route data and validation determine progress. Session state is persisted; the phone presents bounded text, bird cues and accepted fixed speech. Audio transcription is a separate editable-draft flow.
